text:
[LCRS.4.2.1] The `CallError` schema is `ttl`-scoped at 5_min. The adapter
asserts it instead of the response fact ([LCRS.4.3.1]) when it could not
fulfil the request.

| Slot | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `corr` | String | correlation from the call's `as` binding |
| `code` | String | error kind ([LCRS.4.2.3]) |
| `message` | String | human-readable detail |
| `ts` | Time | when the error was received ([LFAC.9.2]) |

idris.name: Lcrs_4_2_2__answers
idris.note: CallError's kind among the answer kinds. LESS than the clause: its slots beyond `corr` are the payload's, its 5_min TTL the time map's.

idris.name: Lcrs_4_3_2__corr_of
idris.note: CallError keeps `corr` as its first slot, in the lowering's table. Where a kind keeps its `corr`, the lowering's table read off the declarations. LESS than the clause: that a response schema is `ttl` and declares `corr` as a non-nullable String is the validator's, not modelled.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__wcorr
idris.note: A fixture. The schema's slots are the witnesses' payload.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_4__error_after_response
idris.note: A CallError arriving, computed; its slots are the payload's. A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_4__error_spans_services
idris.note: A CallError spanning services, computed; its slots are the payload's. A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_4__error_sweeps_every_answer
idris.note: A CallError names no service. LESS than the clause: the schema itself is the lowering's.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_4__survivor_kinds_if
idris.note: THE KINDS THAT SURVIVE AN ARRIVAL'S SWEEP, by the two tests on the arriving kind: an answer kind not among the swept kinds is of another response schema and neither is CallError; a CallError sweeps every answer kind; a kind that is no answer sweeps nothing and is none.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_4__swept_by
idris.note: A CallError names no service, so its correlation spans services: the first test. LESS than the clause: the schema's slots and TTL are the lowering's.

tla.name: lcrs_4_2_1__ERROR_TTL
tla.note: CallError's 5_min TTL, in ticks, independent of the response schema's (LCRS.4.3.2), which may be the shorter or the longer. call_response.cfg sets this one the longer so that the two lifetimes are told apart, and call_response.scope.long.cfg runs the clause's engine with it the shorter; call_response.teeth.one_ttl_long.cfg sets it the shorter too, the ordering under which an engine applying one TTL to both kinds keeps a CallError past 5_min.
